title: Evaluación multi-amenaza en cuatro zonas del Uruguay, considerando escenarios de cambio climático. Etapa C: Informe preliminar, Producto 3
organization: Factor CO2 for Uruguay's NAP Ciudades project, with DINAGUA and DINAMA counterparts
temporal_coverage: Report delivered 22 April 2020; local vulnerability indicators use 2011 census data; climate projections cover 2020–2044 and 2045–2099.
methodology: Preliminary multi-hazard GIS combines climate scenarios, urban exposure, census sensitivity and qualitative adaptation capacity.
limitations: Preliminary; local validation pending. Adaptation capacity was not quantified.

title: Uruguay: 2024 Article IV Consultation—Staff Report, IMF Country Report No. 24/215
temporal_coverage: Article IV report completed 14 June 2024; drought analysis includes 2022Q4–2023Q2 and the SMDI reference series 2000–2023.
methodology: IMF macro study uses soil-moisture data, SVAR and DSGE models.
limitations: Weather shocks are not anthropogenic attribution; relocation passage gives no locations.

title: Informe de situación por inundaciones - Fin de la emergencia (08/01/24)
temporal_coverage: Closeout of the 80-day Uruguay River flood emergency of October 2023–January 2024.
methodology: National emergency situation report drawing on SINAE, DINAGUA, meteorological and departmental response information.
limitations: Event-specific official reporting; it does not attribute the flood to long-term anthropogenic climate change.

title: Balance anual de emergencias: los eventos adversos más significativos de 2024
temporal_coverage: Annual emergency balance for 2024, published 10 January 2025.
methodology: SINAE annual summary of hydrometeorological emergencies with affected-people and housing tables by event and department.
limitations: This event inventory reports impacts, not anthropogenic attribution; its aggregate prose conflicts with the table total, so claims use the flood-specific table row or event-specific figures only.
